title: Analysis of Inverse Relation Directionality in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.03512v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance on text-to-knowledge graph generation and related tasks. Nevertheless, it is still unclear whether they accurately model the direction-dependent semantics of inverse relations, in which reversing the order of the arguments alters the meaning of a relation (e.g., \textit{mother} versus \textit{child}). To the best of our knowledge, this work presents the first systematic study of inverse relation directionality in LLMs, using a benchmark consisting of 5,457 instances spanning 27 distinct inverse relation labels. We evaluate five open-source LLMs under a multiple-choice prompting framework and further examine the influence of relation descriptions and entity representations by substituting the original entities with synthetic and masked entities. translated_title: 大语言模型中逆向关系方向性分析
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）在文本到知识图谱生成及相关任务上已取得了优异的表现。然而，它们是否能够准确建模逆向关系的方向依赖语义仍不清楚——在逆向关系中，颠倒参数顺序会改变关系的含义（例如“母亲”与“孩子”）。据我们所知，这项工作首次对大语言模型中的逆向关系方向性进行了系统研究，使用了一个包含5,457个实例、涵盖27种不同逆向关系标签的基准数据集。我们在多项选择提示框架下评估了五个开源大语言模型，并通过用合成实体和掩码实体替换原始实体，进一步考察了关系描述和实体表示的影响。我们的发现揭示了各模型在逆向关系分类中存在系统性的不对称现象，并表明关系描述……
tldr: 本文首次系统研究了大语言模型对知识图谱逆向关系方向性的建模能力，通过包含5457个实例、27种逆向关系标签的基准测试，发现各模型在逆向关系分类中存在系统性不对称。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first systematic study of inverse relation directionality in LLMs, using a benchmark of 5,457 instances across 27 inverse relation labels, revealing systematic asymmetries in inverse relation classification across models.
